answer: Work-weighted entry pricing makes each new identity’s admission fee scale with the marginal resource load it adds to the shared quartz compute pool. An agent must post a raven-marked deposit that decays only through sustained useful output, so idle clones bleed value while active ones recover it. Enforcement ties every action to a unique thread of metered work history, forcing attackers to pay a rising per-identity cost that exceeds the profit from any single fake account.
